integrity: The proof independently identifies the exact affine hull from the active band and the source dimension, computes the orthogonal row-uniform center, checks all vertices have one active unit entry per row, and proves minimum-enclosing optimality and uniqueness from an explicit equal-weight barycentric certificate of consecutive-block vertices. Finite exact-arithmetic enumeration is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the standard diagonal matching-field realization for 2<=k<n with its inherited Euclidean metric. It does not transfer through arbitrary unimodular maps or combinatorial mutations and does not determine the inradius, John ellipsoid, or pairwise distance spectrum. A residual originality risk remains for an equivalent metric observation under exponent-vector or toric terminology.
title: Consecutive blocks certify the exact circumsphere of diagonal matching-field polytopes
